status: Secondary retrospective label-source audit, not a new independent station-validation study
model_policy: Use every China-to-Australia configuration and its already frozen SatPM-development rule. No refitting or model/rule selection using regulatory outcomes.
target: Unweighted mean of eligible regulatory station-month values within the inherited matched FUA; not an area-weighted FUA truth estimate
cohorts: QLD/VIC station-months with recomputable valid-day fraction >=0.75
NSW official monthly values without locally available valid-day counts, reported separately
space: Other FUAs not used by each model's target-development network; keep the same row selection as the frozen prediction gate
comparators: Frozen source-informed prediction and saved equal-budget target-only predictions, all fitted to SatPM labels. Also report contemporaneous SatPM product vs monitors as a label-agreement diagnostic, not a deployable predictor or new baseline training.
limits: Station-month eligibility and existing geographic matching are inherited and audited where available; point-to-area support differs and possible upstream SatPM calibration overlap is unknown. No China regulatory validation, new 2025 target, or universal observed-PM2.5 transfer claim.
